summary: Iteration 27 - P0 Bug Fixes Testing: Resend sandbox domain restriction and Auth state persistence. All 9 backend tests passed. All 8 frontend tests passed. Both P0 issues are FIXED and working correctly.

BACKEND: POST /api/v1/auth/logout invalidates token (subsequent requests return 401)
FRONTEND: Login persists token to localStorage under key 't2t_token'
FRONTEND: Login persists user data to localStorage under key 't2t_user'
FRONTEND: Page reload on /dashboard stays on /dashboard (auth state persisted)
FRONTEND: Token still in localStorage after page reload
FRONTEND: Logout clears t2t_token from localStorage
FRONTEND: Logout clears t2t_user from localStorage
FRONTEND: Forgot password page shows amber sandbox warning banner with AlertTriangle icon

critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py correctly detects sandbox restriction via error message parsing (testing/sandbox/only send/403)
auth.py create_password_reset_otp() is now async and returns {otp, email_sent, sandbox_restricted} dict
server.py forgot-password endpoint correctly reads result dict and includes warning in response
AuthContext.js uses localStorage with keys t2t_token and t2t_user for persistence
AuthContext.js validates token expiry on mount using parseJwt() and clears expired tokens
ProtectedRoute.js and AdminRoute.js check 'restoring' state before redirecting to prevent flash
ForgotPasswordPage.js shows sandbox-warning div with amber styling and toast notification

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all auth persistence and sandbox warning tests passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 verified both P0 fixes: (1) Resend sandbox restriction now returns warning instead of 500 error - the forgot-password endpoint returns {success: true, email_sent: false, warning: '...'} and frontend shows amber warning banner + toast. (2) Auth state persistence now works - login stores token/user in localStorage (t2t_token, t2t_user), page reload stays on dashboard, logout clears localStorage, expired tokens redirect to login. Rate limit on forgot-password is 3/minute.

p0_fix_1_sandbox_restriction.issue: Resend sandbox mode was causing 500 errors when sending to non-verified emails
p0_fix_1_sandbox_restriction.fix: email_service.py now returns {sent, sandbox_restricted, error} dict. auth.py create_password_reset_otp() is async and returns result dict. server.py includes warning in response.
p0_fix_1_sandbox_restriction.verification: Backend returns {email_sent: false, warning: 'Email could not be sent (sandbox mode)...'} instead of 500. Frontend shows amber warning banner and toast.

p0_fix_2_auth_persistence.issue: Page refresh was logging user out - auth state was only in React state
p0_fix_2_auth_persistence.fix: AuthContext.js now persists token and user to localStorage (t2t_token, t2t_user). On mount, validates token expiry and restores state.
p0_fix_2_auth_persistence.verification: Login stores to localStorage, page reload stays on dashboard, logout clears localStorage, expired tokens redirect to login.
